verdict.rationale: There is no documented export feature. The only portability paths are indirect: the document-operations API can list and get ingested documents, which could be scripted into a machine-readable dump, and a self-hosted binary keeps data on your own hardware. Neither path shows that the extracted memories, graph relationships or user profiles can be exported in a portable format. Missing for 10: a dedicated export/bulk-dump endpoint or tool, a documented machine-readable export schema covering memories, graph and profiles, a documented import path into other systems, and independent or hands-on confirmation of portability.
